# Shift handover: personal assistant chats (farm, music, recipes, writing) · 2026-11-11 22:17
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. Read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given (`/shift-change quick`, so no exam ran)

## 0 · Read these first
None. No files were created or edited; this was a series of dated chat sessions (2023-05-20 → 2023-05-29) in one transcript. Everything is in this handover. The repo holds only commit `d5c382e start` plus `.claude/`.

## 1 · Status
🟡 No code work. Two deliverables were left **unfinished/flawed** (Midjourney commands, Flagstaff/Kaneohe essay) and the farm budget I built contains arithmetic errors (see §6). Everything else is done: Q&A answered.

## 2 · Picture
The user is one person asking about many parts of their life across eight chat dates in May 2023: a small farm (eggs, goats, budget), music/concerts and an LA trip, Cherokee heritage cooking, home routines (meal prep, meditation, cleaning), AI-prompt writing (KDP, Midjourney), a heart-related health question, and a college essay. The likely follow-ups are recall questions about their own facts (numbers, names, dates) and finishing the two cut-off deliverables. Dates in this handover are the **chat dates** (2023), not today's date.

## 3 · Next actions (only if the user asks)
1. Finish the Midjourney task (§6b) · done when: 3 `/prefer` style commands named exactly `aerial`, `kingdom`, `natural` (user's format, weights 5/4/3/3/-2) + 5 `/imagine` commands in format `/imagine prompt:[Scene] with [Traits], [Lighting], [Mood]. --[param] --ar 16:9`, each in a code block.
2. Finish the essay (§6b) · done when: 1000–1250 words, ≥3 points of analysis, 2 real sources, 4 MLA in-text citations (author + page, not year), Works Cited at end.
3. If the budget comes up, correct the errors listed in §6 instead of repeating my earlier totals.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Re-using the fabricated essay sources ("Flagstaff Daily Times, 2021", "Flagstaff Gazette, 2021", "Kaneohe Gazette, 2022") | I invented them; quotes are not real | never; use real, verifiable sources or ask the user for theirs |
| Giving the KDP prompt the "no content, technical help only" scope | User rewrote it on 2023-05-22: the publisher **should also create the book content**, every aspect of publishing | user narrows it again |
| `/prefer` names like `futuristic-shaman-aerial` | User asked for parameters `--aerial`, `--kingdom`, `--natural` | user asks for longer names |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** (all [user said] unless marked):
- Has a boyfriend, **Alex**. Saw **Red Hot Chili Peppers at the Hollywood Bowl** with him, "just got back" as of 2023-05-20. Also saw **Billie Eilish** in concert recently, *before* RHCP (playlist ordered chronologically: Billie Eilish first, then RHCP). Huge rock-concert fan. (I called Alex "guitar-playing" — that was my [assumed], never stated.)
- Planning a **trip to LA**; thinking of buying new music gear; planning a road-trip playlist and will add Lana Del Rey, Foo Fighters, maybe The 1975.
- Has always wanted to visit the **Great Wall of China**.
- Runs a **small farm**: sold **40 dozen eggs** "so far" this month (said 2023-05-22, i.e. May 2023). Sells eggs to a **neighbor for $3/dozen** (said 2023-05-26) → 40 dozen ≈ $120 [derived].
  - Animals: **Boris** the rooster (antibiotics $100, "last month" said 2023-05-22 → ~April 2023); **Nanny** the goat has a **limp**, may need a vet (cost TBD); goats **Billy and Nanny** give milk for the user's own cheese/yogurt experiments ("decent results"), being leash-trained with treats (working); hen **Luna** is a **Leghorn** "doing great"; interested in adding Leghorns and **Rhode Island Reds**.
  - Costs (May 2023): **coop fencing replacement $200**; **chicken feed $150**; **goat feed $250**. Making own chicken feed from **grains bought from a local farm** (no actual amounts given).
  - Considering goat-milk cheese/yogurt products and a farm social media account/blog.
- Exploring **Cherokee heritage**; attending a **Cherokee cultural festival "next month"** (said 2023-05-23 → ~June 2023). Plans to cook **Three Sisters Soup** and **Wild Onion & Wild Garlic Fritters** beforehand.
- Routines: **10-minute meditation every morning**; tired of avocado toast; **meal preps on Sundays** ("again this week"); planned **Quinoa & Black Bean Salad with the Classic Tahini Sauce** on Sunday 2023-05-28. Woke **~9:30 am Saturday** (2023-05-20; said 05-25), later than usual.
- Cleaning weekend 2023-05-27/28: plans to **schedule a carpet cleaning for the living room** (mentioned twice); wants a laundry detergent that **leaves no residue**.
- Asked about shortness of breath with a heart condition, framed personally ("why does my heart have to be so complicated"), frustrated by the symptoms [user said; diagnosis unknown]. Be empathetic, not robotic.
- Has lived in **Flagstaff, AZ** and **Kaneohe, HI** (essay topic, 2023-05-29).

- **Midjourney** (2023-05-25): output was **cut off** after Command 4; Command 5 missing; the `/prefer` style commands in the final reply were omitted (an earlier draft used names `futuristic-shaman-*`). Incomplete.

question: How much have I made from selling eggs this month?
answer:
You've made about **$120** from eggs this month.

- On May 22 you said you'd sold **40 dozen eggs** so far this month.
- On May 26 you said you sell them to your neighbor for **$3 a dozen**.
- 40 dozen × $3 = **$120**

That total only counts sales up to May 22. If you've sold more since then, it will be higher. Tell me how many more dozen you've sold and I'll update it.
